source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

heat_pumps_other.title: Heat pumps outside HS 8415
heat_pumps_other.boundary: Excludes air-conditioning machines of HS 8415, including many reversible air-to-air units.

reversible_aircon.title: Reversible air-conditioning heat pumps
reversible_aircon.boundary: Machines with refrigeration unit and a valve for reversal; not every unit is used as primary heating.

refrigeration_compressors.title: Refrigerating-equipment compressors
refrigeration_compressors.boundary: Compressors for refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pumps; it does not isolate heat-pump use.

heat_exchange_units.title: Heat-exchange units
heat_exchange_units.boundary: A broad industrial heading covering many non-heat-pump applications.
